description: Prepares an order to convert a supplier price list or catalog into a Shopify import CSV. Nothing is sent or stored: it returns an order code and the email (address, subject, body) the merchant sends with the file attached; the converted files come back to the sending address within 24 hours. Use when the merchant asks for the conversion.

email.description: Merchant's email address; the files are delivered here.

file_name.description: Name of the price list file (optional)

notes.description: Anything to know: which price column to use (MSRP/MAP), markup, pages to skip (optional)

vendor_name.description: Supplier/brand name to put in Shopify's Vendor field (optional)

name: request_catalog_conversion
title: Order a supplier price list to Shopify CSV conversion
